card.what: Tiller extension (hiking stick): a ribbed urethane universal joint on a plate screwed to the tiller, a ferrule into a 19 mm anodised tube, a textured grip at the far end and a rubber end knob
card.boats: J/22 (Tools/boatkit/layouts/j22.json at TillerExtUJ, 1000 mm), Sunfish (914 mm, the factory's 36 in), ILCA (1070-1220 mm); the game draws the live one from the TillerEnd socket
card.distance: in the helm's hand: the closest thing to the cockpit camera
card.before: kit TillerExtension from bk_parts.tiller_extension (Oct 2026): aluminium tube on a lathed rubber joint with no plate, a smooth black grip, a plain knob

references.note: Ronstan Battlestick: anodised aluminium 5/8 or 3/4 in tube, urethane universal joint RF3133 with a snap-on cover plate, grip at the outboard end; lengths 24 to 49 in. Harken length guide: 42 in Sunfish/Laser recreation, 48 in Laser racing; Sunfish factory 36 in

sizes.name: Overall, the joint plate's front to the knob's end

features.text: Joint plate screwed to the tiller (two screws)
Ferrule from the joint into the tube
Textured grip at the far end

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
